caption:
A small moon of Saturn sprays ice into space.

The Sun is behind Enceladus, 500 km wide.
Plumes glow at the bottom and spray from the south pole.
The spray feeds Saturn’s E ring and keeps the surface bright as snow.

What the astronomers say: the plumes likely link to an ocean under the ice shell.

NASA picture of the day, 5 Nov 2026. Cassini Imaging Team, SSI, JPL, ESA, NASA
